changeSet.author: antigravity
changeSet.comment: Add GIN and Keyset Seek indexing, Spring Modulith Persistent Outbox, and DLQ Triage tables
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS UNIPOST_EVENT_PUBLICATIONS ( id UUID NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, event_type VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, listener_id VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, serialized_event TEXT NOT NULL, publication_date TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, completion_date TIMESTAMPTZ NULL );
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_event_publications_uncompleted ON UNIPOST_EVENT_PUBLICATIONS (completion_date) WHERE completion_date IS NULL;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS UNIPOST_DLQ_MESSAGES ( id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, execution_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, step_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, error_reason TEXT NOT NULL, payload JSONB NOT NULL, retry_count INT DEFAULT 0, status VARCHAR(32) DEFAULT 'PENDING', created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp() );
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_dlq_tenant_status ON UNIPOST_DLQ_MESSAGES (tenant_id, status);
